title: Friends who fought the CIA and DNI internally
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Friends who fought the CIA and DNI internally, about 2020s at CIA / ODNI, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Like I have friends who went to war with me against the CIA and DNI internally like went to war and said I can prove you're lying and did so.

plain: Dylan Borland, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, says he has friends who took on the CIA, the US spy agency, and the DNI, the office that oversees all US spy agencies, from the inside during the 2020s. According to him, they told those agencies they could prove the agencies were lying, and then did. If true, it would mean insiders had caught the intelligence world hiding something.
